title: Winnebago Industries, Inc.: WINNEBAGO/EQUIPMENT: CERTIFICATION LABEL (39 affected)
summary: THE CERTIFICATION LABEL ON THESE VEHICLES CONTAIN INCORRECT TIRE PRESSURE DATA.  THIS DOES NOT CONFORM TO THE REQUIREMENTS OF FEDERAL MOTOR VEHICLE SAFETY STANDARD NO. 120, "TIRE  SELECTION AND RIMS FOR MOTOR VEHICLES OTHER THAN PASSENGER CARS."

title: Ford Motor Company: FORD/STRUCTURE; FRAME; MEMBERS AND BODY (200 affected)
summary: THE CROSSMEMBER FRAME GUSSETS WERE INSTALLED WITH UNDERSIZED THREADED FASTENERS FOLLOWING A BREAKDOWN OF THE PRODUCTION RIVET GUN THAT IS GENERALLY USED.  THIS GUSSET IS THE ATTACHMENT POINT FOR THE REAR STRAP OF THE MID-SHIP FUEL TANK.

title: WESTERN STAR TRUCKS, INC.: WESTERN STAR/BRAKES; HYDRAULIC. (88 affected)
summary: THE BRAKE RETURN SPRING CAN CONTACT THE HUB.  FURTHER WEAR OF THE BRAKE LINING MATERIAL WILL LEAD TO WEAR OF THE RETURN SPRING AND THE SPRING CAN FAIL PREMATURELY.

title: WESTERN STAR TRUCKS, INC.: WESTERN STAR/SUSPENSION (36 affected)
summary: THE EQUALIZING BEAM SHAFT OF THE TANDEM AXLE SUSPENSION WERE MANUFACTURED FROM AS-ROLLED SAE4140 STEEL RATHER THAN THE SPECIFIED ANNEALED SAE4140.  THESE SHAFTS CAN FRACTURE INSIDE THE BEAM AT THE TOE OF THE WELD.

title: INTERNATIONAL TRUCK & ENGINE CORPORATION: NAVISTAR/SUSPENSION (21 affected)
summary: THE EQUALIZING BEAM SHAFT OF THE TANDEM AXLE SUSPENSION WERE MANUFACTURED FROM AS-ROLLED SAE4140 STEEL RATHER THAN THE SPECIFIED ANNEALED SAE4140.  THESE SHAFTS CAN FRACTURE INSIDE THE BEAM AT THE TOE OF THE WELD.

title: Mazda North American Operations: MAZDA/BRAKE; HYDRAULIC; CHECK VALVE (13,900 affected)
summary: OIL MIST CONTAINED IN THE ENGINE INTAKE AIR CAN COLLECT OVER TIME IN THE BRAKE VACUUM CHECK VALVE PREVENTING THE CHECK VALVE FROM OPENING AT THE SPECIFIED PRESSURE REDUCING POWER ASSIST TO THE BRAKES.

title: Winnebago Industries, Inc.: WINNEBAGO/FUEL; LPG LINES; NON-METALLIC. (30 affected)
summary: THE LIQUID PROPANE (LP) GAS SUPPLY HOSE LOCATED ADJACENT TO THE LP TANK CAN CONTACT THE TANK PLUMBING GUARD CAUSING THE HOSE TO WEAR THROUGH ALLOWING LP GAS TO BE RELEASED.

title: Trans-Air Manufacturing Corp.: STEERING: POWER ASSIST (222 affected)
summary: A GENERAL MOTORS (GM) HOSE WHICH DIRECTS THE POWER STEERING FLUID FROM THE POWER STEERING RESERVOIR TO THE POWER STEERING PUMP REQUIRED RELOCATION TO ACCOMMODATE THE AIR CONDITIONING COMPRESSOR.  THE SUBSTITUTE HOSE WAS NOT COMPATIBLE FOR USE WITH POWER STEERING FLUID CAUSING THE HOSE TO DETERIORATE.

title: EIS BRAKE PARTS: BRAKES; HYDRAULIC; LINES; HOSE. (50 affected)
summary: THESE HOSE ASSEMBLIES DO NOT CONTAIN THE ASSEMBLER'S IDENTIFICATION.  THIS DOES NOT COMPLY WITH FEDERAL MOTOR VEHICLE SAFETY STANDARD NO. 106, "BRAKE HOSES."

title: CARPENTER INDUSTRIES, INC.: CARPENTER/SEAT TRACK ANCHORS (18 affected)
summary: THE SEAT PEDESTALS ARE FATIGUE CRACKING ADJACENT TO THE WELD WHICH SECURES THE PEDESTAL'S UPPER PLATE TO THE UPPER, TELESCOPING PORTION OF THE ADJUSTABLE COLUMN SUPPORT.

title: FLEETWOOD ENTERPRISES, INC.: FLEETWOOD/AUXILLIARY GENERATOR (260 affected)
summary: THE  "O" RINGS OF THE REGULATOR ASSEMBLY IN THE ONAN EMERALD AND MARQUIS BRAND GENERATOR SETS CAN WEAKEN AND BREAK WHEN EXPOSED TO HIGH AMBIENT TEMPERATURES.

title: Porsche Cars North America, Inc.: PORSCHE/STEERING; COLUMN (12,538 affected)
summary: A PART OF THE STEERING COLUMN UPPER UNIVERSAL JOINT CRACKED DURING THE MANUFACTURING PROCESS.

title: ADVANCE MIXER, INC.: ADVANCE/SUSPENSION (538 affected)
summary: THE EQUALIZING BEAM SHAFT OF THE TANDEM AXLE SUSPENSION WERE MANUFACTURED FROM AS-ROLLED SAE4140 STEEL RATHER THAN THE SPECIFIED ANNEALED SAE4140.  THESE SHAFTS CAN FRACTURE INSIDE THE BEAM AT THE TOE OF THE WELD.

title: KEYSTONE, INC.: KING OF THE ROAD/RV AWNINGS (259 affected)
summary: THE AWNINGS FOR THE SLIDE-OUT ROOM CAN UNFURL OR UNROLL DURING TRANSIT CAUSING THE BRACKET TO RIP FREE OF THE SIDEWALL OF THE VEHICLE.

title: Ford Motor Company: FORD/FUEL; FUEL INJECTION; REGULATOR (4,700 affected)
summary: THE FUEL PRESSURE REGULATOR LOCATED ON THE FUEL RAIL IN THE ENGINE COMPARTMENT HAS A VACUUM DIAPHRAGM THAT WAS DAMAGED DURING MANUFACTURE OF THE REGULATOR.

title: MITSUBISHI CARIBBEAN: MITSUBISHI CARIBBEAN/BRAKE HOSES (10,000 affected)
summary: UNDER CONDITIONS OF FULL LOCK STEERING AND FULL SUSPENSION TRAVEL, THE LEFT OR RIGHT FRONT WHEEL-SIDE BRAKE HOSE CAN CRACK, RESULTING IN BRAKE FLUID LEAKAGE.

title: ISRINGHAUSEN: ISRINGHAUSEN/SEATS (36 affected)
summary: TWO WELDS LOCATED ON THE BACK REST ADJUSTMENT SIDE OF THE SEAT FRAME DID NOT MEET THE MANUFACTURER'S SPECIFICATIONS.

title: RANSOMES CORPORATION: RANSOME/BRAKES; HYDRAULIC; LINES. (1,413 affected)
summary: A CHANGE IN THE FRONT FORK MADE TO ACCOMMODATE THE 12" WHEEL CAN CAUSE EXCESSIVE BRAKE LINE STRETCH WHEN THE FORK IS BOTTOMED OUT.  THIS CAN CAUSE THE LINE TO LEAK BRAKE FLUID.

title: INTERNATIONAL TRUCK & ENGINE CORPORATION: NAVISTAR/STEERING; COLUMN. (215 affected)
summary: THE STEERING COLUMN USED WAS INCORRECTLY MANUFACTURED.  THE TUBE PORTION OF THE STEERING COLUMN HAS A WELDED END WITH A SPECIFIED LENGTH OF 5.5 INCHES.  A 3.5 INCH WELDED END WAS USED BY MISTAKE.  WITH THE SHORTER END, IT IS POSSIBLE THERE IS INSUFFICIENT ENGAGEMENT OF THE MALE END INTO THE TUBE PORTION AND SEPARATION OF THE COLUMN COULD OCCUR.

title: Volvo Car USA, LLC: ENGINE. (400 affected)
summary: ENGINE BLOCK HEATERS INSTALLED AS ACCESSORIES.  THE BLOCK HEATER CONTACT SURFACE DOES NOT MATCH CORRECTLY WITH THE ENGINE BLOCK AS INTENDED.  THE BLOCK HEATER COULD COME LOOSE FROM THE ENGINE BLOCK, AND IF BEING USED, COULD POSSIBLY OVERHEAT CAUSING DAMAGE IF IT COMES IN CONTACT WITH OTHER ENGINE COMPARTMENT COMPONENTS.

title: General Motors, LLC: GM/INTERIOR; SEATS. (3,472 affected)
summary: THE FRONT PASSENGER SEATS HAVE LESS LOCK PAWL ENGAGEMENT ON THE INBOARD FORE/AFT ADJUSTER THAN SPECIFIED.  THIS DOES NOT COMPLY WITH FEDERAL MOTOR VEHICLE SAFETY STANDARD NO. 207, "SEATING SYSTEMS."

title: Oshkosh Corporation: FREIGHTLINER-OSHKOSH/EQUIPMENT; SPEED CONTROL. (4,855 affected)
summary: WHEN THE CHASSIS/VEHICLE IS OPERATED ON A HIGHWAY AND THE CRUISE CONTROL SYSTEM IS TURNED ON, WITH THE SPEED SET, IF THE STOP/HAZARD FUSE HAS FAILED, THE CRUISE CONTROL WILL NOT DISENGAGE WHEN THE BRAKE PEDAL IS DEPRESSED.

title: Volvo Trucks North America: VOLVO TRUCK/BRAKES; HYDRAULIC. (149 affected)
summary: THE REAR MOST AXLE OF THE TANDEM AXLE SET COULD HAVE INOPERABLE BRAKES ON ONE OR BOTH WHEELS BECAUSE THE BRAKE S-CAM WAS INCORRECTLY INSTALLED.

title: Mitsubishi Motors North America, Inc.: MITSUBISHI/FUEL (5,731 affected)
summary: THE FUEL TANK GASKETS FOR THE FUEL PUMP AND/OR GAUGE UNIT GASKET COULD HAVE BEEN INCORRECTLY INSTALLED ALLOWING FUEL OR FUMES TO ESCAPE.

title: Chrysler (FCA US, LLC): CHRYSLER/FUEL (9,616 affected)
summary: THE FUEL TANK GASKETS FOR THE FUEL PUMP AND/OR GAUGE UNIT GASKET COULD HAVE BEEN INCORRECTLY INSTALLED ALLOWING FUEL OR FUMES TO ESCAPE.

title: Oshkosh Corporation: FREIGHTLINER-OSHKOSH/SUSPENSION (1,597 affected)
summary: WITH NO AIR IN BOTH FRONT AXLE AIR SUSPENSION AIR BAGS, THE CHASSIS SUSPENSION WILL LOWER TO THE SUSPENSION STOP.  WHEN THAT OCCURS, THE TRACK BAR BRACKET CAN CONTACT THE AXLE STEERING TIE ROD.

title: IL LI INDUSTRIAL CO., LTD.: PHILLIPS/HEADLAMP BULBS (515,000 affected)
summary: THE DIMENSIONS OF THESE HEADLAMP BULBS DO NOT COMPLY WITH FMVSS NO. 108, "LAMPS, REFLECTIVE DEVICES, AND ASSOCIATED EQUIPMENT."

title: General Motors, LLC: GM/VISUAL; WINDSHIELD (50 affected)
summary: THESE VEHICLES WERE BUILT WITH AN INCORRECT WIPER BLADE ASSEMBLY (17" LONG INSTEAD OF 22" LONG) ON THE DRIVER'S SIDE.  THIS DOES NOT COMPLY WITH FMVSS NO. 104, "WINDSHIELD WIPING AND WASHING SYSTEMS."

title: Ford Motor Company: FORD/EQUIPMENT; CERTIFICATION LABEL (134,770 affected)
summary: THE CERTIFICATION LABELS ON THE INVOLVED VEHICLES HAS INCORRECT REAR TIRE INFLATION PRESSURE DESIGNATIONS.  THIS DOES NOT COMPLY WITH FMVSS NO. 120, "TIRE SELECTION AND RIMS FOR MOTOR VEHICLES OTHER THAN PASSENGER CARS."
